messages:
mira: heads-up, PR #14645 is blocked by a flaky snapshot failure in CI, can someone poke?
ci-bot: build 14645.2 failed on linux-integration (exit 1) — https://ci.example.com/builds/14645.2
ci-bot: failing job: integration-linux-shard-3 (tests: integrations/kv/test_prefix.py::test_prefix_eviction)
alex: looking now, did this start after the recent kv prefix change?
mira: yeah I rebased onto main earlier, the diff is just a tiny refactor + a snapshot update i intended to include but forgot to run locally
jonathan: quick question — does the failure look like a real assertion or a snapshot mismatch?
alex: logs show an assertion: expected key list to be [a, b] but got [a] — then a snapshot assert on the TTL output
alex: log snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: Lists differ: [
-    'item-b',
] vs [
]

/opt/ci/workspace/integrations/kv/test_prefix.py:73: AssertionError
```
sam: I've seen this flake before when the shard ordering changes under load, usually rerunning the shard fixes it.
mira: can we do a targeted rerun instead of full pipeline? that would be faster.
ci-bot: to rerun a single job, comment `rerun job integration-linux-shard-3` on the PR or click the job > rerun in the UI.
jonathan: @alex can you try a rerun first? if it flakes again we'll run the snapshot update flow.
alex: rerunning now (commented `rerun job integration-linux-shard-3`) — kicked off build 14645.3
ci-bot: build 14645.3 started — integration-linux-shard-3
mira: thanks. if it passes, we can proceed with merge. if it fails again i'll run the tests locally and update the snapshot.
alex: build 14645.3 passed ✅ — integration-linux-shard-3 green
alex: happy path looks clear, I also ran the small repro locally; couldn't reproduce the missing item.
mira: ok i'll merge after CI gates are green across all shards (waiting on one more windows job).
ci-bot: build 14645.4 started — windows-integration
jonathan: quick FYI — if we see this repeatedly on shard-3, we might want to add a small retry around the eviction timing in the test harness rather than widening the snapshot.
sam: +1 on avoiding snapshot drift; test harness tweak seems better if it's timing-related.
mira: agreed. created an issue to track (link: https://issues.example.com/RED-789) and i'll follow up post-merge.
alex: windows job passed, all gates green, merging in 2m unless someone objects. :shipit:
mira: no objections, merging. thanks everyone :tada:
ci-bot: PR #14645 merged by mira — build 14645.5 starting post-merge checks
ci-bot: post-merge checks passed — deployment pipeline proceeding
mira: filing a small follow-up PR to add a retry in the test harness so we don't regress. will tag reviewers.
